In the summer, you choose clothes that keep you cool and comfortable.
You are responding to your body’s signals; your body is sensing the weather.
Weather is a state of the Earth’s atmosphere Stratosphere at a particular time and Tropopause Ozone Layer place.
In simple terms, it is the layer of Troposphere gases that surround some planets — in the case of our Earth, we call these gases ‘air’.
The layer closest to the surface of the Earth is called the ‘troposphere’, and that is where all land-based plants and animals (including humans!) live and breathe.
